description:
Rip through sand, dirt and snow with the Malus 26-inch fat tire bike! Built with 4" tires (earning the name fat) on a supersized beach cruiser frame and there is plenty of clearance to make it rideable on virtually any terrain. Plus, the Malus has 7-speeds with a Shimano rear derailleur and front and rear disc brakes, so it still has its vein of practicality.
Steel mountain-style fat tire frame, alloy a-head stem, and MTB handlebar.
7-speed drivetrain with Shimano rear derailleur for smooth gear changes.
Front and rear disc brakes for crisp stopping and precise speed control.
Fat, knobby 4" wide MTB tires on light, durable 4" alloy rims.
